title: Excited to see the @goifoundation #OER platform take root. We are holding our first kick off meeting this Wednesday 14:00 UTC. Join in person in Accra
summary: Excited to see the @goifoundation #OER platform take root. We are holding our first kick off meeting this Wednesday 14:00 UTC. Join in person in Accra or remote for our first Homebrew Website Club. #OER begins with you. Curate and write yourself on the world.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Excited to see the @goifoundation #OER platform take root. We are holding our first kick off meeting this Wednesday 14:00 UTC. Join in person in Accra or remote for our first Homebrew Website Club.

#OER begins with you. Curate and write yourself on the world.
